lines.speaker: hecate
lines.text: Every road has a gate, and every gate has a keeper. At this one, you find me.

lines.speaker: hecate
lines.text: I hold two gifts. You may carry one. Ask for the other, and the first returns to my hand.

lines.speaker: hecate
lines.text: Come back whenever the road turns. I am not a generous god, but I am a patient one.
